reason: Radix keeps the closed SelectContent in a detached DocumentFragment (react-select 2.3.8 index.mjs L285-299) so items register and the selected ItemText reaches SelectValue without anything in the document. Rails cannot render a detached fragment, so the closed Content markup is server-rendered inside an inert <template> next to the Trigger; template content is not part of the document tree (no [data-slot] node, no box, no a11y node) and the chadcn--select controller removes the <template> element on connect(), so the post-connect DOM equals Radix. First paint (and no-JS) only.
api: Select takes id: (no Radix prop): the id of the content (the listbox the trigger controls), the group and item-text ids being <id>-group-N and <id>-text-N (one counter); Radix numbers ids with React's useId (unique per tree, no caller control); the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence), and the root takes an explicit base
structure: template sibling of Select::Trigger before connect()
